checks.name: Prep-only boundary
checks.evidence: Generated outputs are manifests, source text excerpts, packet plans, and reports only. No merged/, graph/, timeline/, extracted/, normalized/, or formal entity/event/relationship records were created.

checks.name: Candidate-only missing cast policy
checks.evidence: missing-cast-candidates.json and dead-apostles-roa.json explicitly forbid formalization from mentions only and require direct source reads for supporting cast / direct Roa or Dead Apostle records.

findings.detail: Several supporting Tsukihime cast and Dead Apostle figures are included only as candidate scopes or indirect mentions in this Stage 1 prep. Direct profile entries may exist in the raw DLC worldbook but were not exhaustively read in this generator pass.
findings.recommendedFutureAction: Future extractor should search/read direct entries for Akiha, SHIKI, Hisui, Kohaku, Satsuki, Noel, FROV, Nero Chaos, Wallachia, Sion, Merem, and Roa before formalization.

findings.detail: Audit used structural read/find/grep evidence rather than an executable JSON parser, because shell/scripts were forbidden. JSON appears syntactically formed by inspection and successful tool writes, but no parser command proof is claimed.
findings.recommendedFutureAction: A future allowed structural JSON tool, if available, can validate syntax before downstream extraction.

findings.detail: Line-addressable source text files are curated excerpts rather than full raw entries to avoid repeated raw copies. This is acceptable for prep but future extraction may need to return to raw worldbook entries for complete coverage.
findings.recommendedFutureAction: Use source-unit-manifest rawEntryComment/rawLabels as search anchors for direct rereads during Stage 2 extraction.
